title: Wso2am: Netty, an asynchronous, event-driven network application framework, has a vulnerability starting in version 4…
description: A high-severity vulnerability exists in the wso2am package due to a flaw in Netty, an asynchronous, event-driven network application framework, affecting versions prior to 4.4.0-r1. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity. A fix is available in version 4.4.0-r1.
